description: This file serves as the server entry point for a Remix application, handling HTTP requests by rendering React components server-side and managing CORS headers. It distinguishes between bot and browser clients for streaming server-side rendering.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that sets CORS headers, handles OPTIONS requests, and delegates rendering to either handleBotRequest or handleBrowserRequest based on the user-agent.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot clients using streaming approach, managing rendering lifecycle events and streaming the response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser clients using streaming approach, similar to handleBotRequest.
